entities.summary: Olivier Charroin is a French former professional tennis player. He competes on the ATP Challenger Tour and ITF Futures, mainly in doubles competition. He reached his highest ATP singles ranking, No. 523 on 23 June 2008, and his highest ATP doubles ranking, No. 84, on 21 May 2012.
